name: Watch PR372 E2E rerun
command:
gh run watch 37339206119 --exit-status --interval 30
echo "e2e_rerun_exit=$status"
gh pr checks 372 2>&1 | grep -vE "skipping|pass\b"

description: Watch the re-run of PR #372's failed E2E job, then print the final checks verdict; no merge action
